response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished full-stack/web software engineer with ~15 years of experience across web, mobile, and some embedded/desktop work, but there is essentially no overlap with the core requirements of this Principal Performance Architect role. There is no evidence of SoC or IP modeling, RTL/architectural simulation, hardware-software co-design, AI accelerator or GPU architecture work, SIMD/MIMD experience, or deep neural network training/inference optimization. The only adjacent signals are C/C++ work on LabWindows/CVI, low-latency service work in D, and a wave-field-synthesis thesis — none of which approach principal-level hardware performance architecture. Education (BS CS) meets the 8+ years bar formally, but the domain experience required is absent.
strengths: Extensive, long-tenured software engineering career (15+ years)
Some low-level C/C++ and low-latency, high-throughput systems experience
Strong engineering practices, open-source output, and teaching/communication track record
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling or hardware architecture experience
No AI accelerator, GPU, or deep-learning workload optimization background
Profile is web/full-stack oriented, not performance architecture at principal level

key_factors.factor: Missing SoC/IP modeling and hardware co-design experience
No AI accelerator / GPU / DNN optimization background
Seniority and years of general software experience
